Definition: to pitch over or reel; hence (transitively) to cast down or out
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hurl, cast; 1a) (Pilpel) to throw away, carry away, hurl; 1b) (Hiphil) to throw, cast, cast out; 1c)(Hophal); 1c1) to be hurled, hurled down; 1c2) to be cast, be thrown, be cast out, be thrown down
